autoTile-image.label: Image
autoTile-image.tip: Select the image of the tile sprite sheet

autoTile-x.label: Offset X
autoTile-x.tip: Start fetching tiles from the specified horizontal position

autoTile-y.label: Offset Y
autoTile-y.tip: Start fetching tiles from the specified vertical position

autoTile-templates.label: Templates
autoTile-templates.tip: List of templates for the auto tiles

autoTile-nodes.label: Tiles
autoTile-nodes.tip:
List all possible auto tiles
When setting tiles on the tile map, it checks adjacent rules of sub-tiles in sequence and selects the first matching tile
If none match, the first tile is selected as the default

autoTile-frames.label: Frames
autoTile-frames.tip: If multiple animation frames are set, the animation loops at a fixed frame interval

autoTile-canvas.label: View
autoTile-canvas.tip: Preview the selected animation frame, click to edit

autoTile-rule-grid.label: Neighbors
autoTile-rule-grid.tip:
Check if there are adjacent tiles with the same type
Arrow: The adjacent tile in this direction is the same as this tile
Cross: The adjacent tile in this direction is different from this tile
Blank: The adjacent tile in this direction can be any tile
